answer_1.quote: The ability to generate responses with consistent personas is important towards building intelligent dialogue agents... generated responses need to be relevant to the dialogue context as well as consistent with personas.

answer_2.quote: We adopt multiple widely used metrics to measure the response quality, including Perplexity (PPL), BLEU, BERTScore, Distinct-n, Entropy-n, C-score.

answer_3.quote: C-score ... use the output of an NLI model trained on the DialogueNLI dataset to indicate the consistency between a response and persona sentences.

answer_4.quote: We randomly selected 200 samples from the test set for human evaluations. Five professional annotators ... were asked to rate the responses from three aspects: 1) Fluency; 2) Coherence with the dialogue history; 3) Persona consistency.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each response on Fluency (3‑point scale), Coherence (3‑point scale), and Persona consistency (binary).
